name: Con Dao food guide
summary: Take hạt bàng from the daily market, roasted with salt or candied. Báo Đồng Nai prints 250,000–400,000 đồng per kilogram, depending on the type. Evening is the night market on Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng, where you choose the seafood and the stall cooks it. Where a price or an hour was not printed, it is Check on arrival.
body: Buy hạt bàng when you leave. Báo Đồng Nai, 11 July 2025, shows traders packing the kernels at the daily market and prints 250,000–400,000 đồng per kilogram, depending on the type. The fruit is roasted with salt or candied. Peak-season supply is bought in from the eastern and western provinces, so the bag is not always island fruit. Vietnam Tourism also describes a salt roast and a sugar roast, and fruit in July and August. On the prison use of the tree, Báo Đồng Nai says prisoners gathered leaves and fruit when they were kept without greens. Vietnam Tourism says they used the leaves and fruit as food, as insulation, as paper, and to mark the year. Both stay.

The same Đồng Nai report names cua mặt trăng, cá mú đỏ, gỏi cá mập, cá mó cát and cá mó sáp, sá sùng, mắm nhum, mắm hàu, fresh squid, dried squid, one-sun squid, and cá thu một nắng. Mắm nhum is the one it describes: salty, sour, and strongly fragrant, eaten with rice noodles, boiled meat, and hot rice. VOV, 6 May 2025, adds bánh quy hạt bàng and says one-sun squid and one-sun mackerel are OCOP three-star products.

Evening is the night market. Báo Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, 16 May 2025, names grilled tiger prawn, steamed swimming crab, ốc hương with lemongrass, a seafood hotpot, and tôm mũ ni with garlic, plus grilled rice paper and cơm cháy. Vietnam Tourism and Báo Điện Biên Phủ, 31 July 2026, add ốc vú nàng and lobster. A breakfast dish and a local drink were not named. Where a price or an hour was not printed, it is Check on arrival.
specialtiesLead: Hạt bàng is the pack from the daily market. Ferments, one-sun seafood, and the night-market plates follow.

sections.heading: Packs from the daily market
paragraphs: These are the gift foods Báo Đồng Nai and VOV name. The daytime hour of chợ Côn Đảo was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Hat bang
spots.note: Roasted with salt or candied. Báo Đồng Nai prints 250,000–400,000 đồng per kilogram, depending on the type. Peak-season fruit is also bought in from the eastern and western provinces. The daytime hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Mam nhum
spots.note: Sea-urchin ferment. Báo Đồng Nai says salty, sour, and strongly fragrant, eaten with rice noodles, boiled meat, and hot rice. No price was printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Mam hau
spots.note: Oyster ferment made by hand, in Báo Đồng Nai. Sides were not printed. No price was printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh quy hat bang
spots.note: OCOP three-star biscuits, VOV, 6 May 2025. Chocolate and traditional fillings. Hotel desks stocked them before the workshop. No price was printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Muc mot nang
spots.note: One-sun squid. Báo Đồng Nai lists it as a gift pack. VOV says the product is OCOP three stars from 2024. A cooking note and a price were not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Muc kho
spots.note: Dried squid, separate from the one-sun pack and from fresh squid. Báo Đồng Nai printed no cooking note and no price. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ca thu mot nang
spots.note: One-sun mackerel. VOV says it is OCOP three stars from 2024. A cooking note and a price were not printed. Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Seafood on the island
paragraphs: Báo Đồng Nai names these as island seafood. Vietnam Tourism and Báo Điện Biên Phủ add ốc vú nàng and lobster. A street number was not printed for the seaside restaurants. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Cua mat trang
spots.note: Red spots like a moon. Báo Đồng Nai says the meat is best in the week of the rising moon. Seaside menus, per Báo Điện Biên Phủ. No price was printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ca mu do
spots.note: Rare, and local to the coral, in Báo Đồng Nai. Vietnam Tourism also calls it song fish and prints up to 30 kilograms, most often 5. No price was printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Goi ca map
spots.note: Shark salad. Báo Đồng Nai printed no species and no method. No price was printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ca mo cat
spots.note: Also called cá mó sáp. Báo Đồng Nai does not describe the fish. No price was printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Sa sung
spots.note: Báo Đồng Nai calls it rare and says it was once a tribute item. A cooking note was not printed. No price was printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Muc tuoi
spots.address: Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng
spots.note: Hand-lined from day-boats. Báo Đồng Nai says it is still moving at the tank. The night market steams or grills it from 17:00. No price was printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Oc vu nang
spots.note: Spire snail. Báo Điện Biên Phủ says boil or grill it. Vietnam Tourism also names sauté, salad, and a steam in a little water. The fishing village has no street number. No price was printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Tom hum do
spots.note: Vietnam Tourism says smaller, firmer, and sweeter, nicknamed fire lobster. That account says both a farming kingdom and wild-only catch. Báo Điện Biên Phủ names tôm hùm and does not say red. No price was printed. Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Plates at the night market
paragraphs: Báo Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, 16 May 2025, ate these plates at the open yard. One dinner of the five seafood plates was 1,200,000 đồng for five people. That figure is the dinner, not a price for any one plate. The yard also sells grilled skewers, corn, and sweet potato. A preparation for those three was not printed.

spots.name: Tom su nuong
spots.address: Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng
spots.note: Grilled tiger prawn. You choose the animal and the stall cooks it. The market opens at 17:00. A prawn price was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ghe hap
spots.address: Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng
spots.note: Steamed swimming crab. This is not cua mặt trăng. A crab price was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Oc huong hap sa
spots.address: Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng
spots.note: Ốc hương steamed with lemongrass. A snail price was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Lau hai san
spots.address: Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng
spots.note: Seafood hotpot. The broth was not described. A pot price was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Tom mu ni chay toi
spots.address: Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng
spots.note: Tôm mũ ni with garlic. Báo Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu does not describe the animal further. A plate price was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh trang nuong
spots.address: Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng
spots.note: Grilled rice paper. Toppings were not printed. No price was printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Com chay
spots.address: Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng
spots.note: White rice, pandan green, and magenta leaf, with scallion oil and pork floss. Báo Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu printed 100,000 đồng for one tray at one stall. Other stalls were not priced.

sections.heading: Casual dining
paragraphs: The daily market is the hall for the packs. The night market is the open yard in front of it, on Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng, running since 2023. There is no roof, so rain moves the tables.

spots.name: Con Dao market
spots.caption: The daytime hall. The night market sits in front of this building.
spots.note: The daytime hall where Báo Đồng Nai shows hạt bàng being packed. A street number and a daytime hour were not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Con Dao night market
spots.address: Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng
spots.note: In front of the daily market, no roof. From 17:00, busiest 19:00–22:00. Peak nights and weekends can run until before 02:00, in Báo Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu. Choose the seafood and the stall steams or grills it. Grilled skewers, corn, and sweet potato are also on the stalls. A preparation for those three was not printed.

seoTitle: Con Dao food guide — hat bang and the night market
seoDescription: Hạt bàng at the daily market, 250,000–400,000 đồng per kilogram in Báo Đồng Nai. Evening seafood is cooked to order on Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng. An unprinted price is Check on arrival.
